newsitem.title: USA: Italian Oven in definitive asset sale deal.
newsitem.headline: Italian Oven in definitive asset sale deal.

text.p: Italian Oven Inc said late Tuesday, after the market closed that it signed a definitive agreement with Whitecliff Group Inc for the sale of the company's assets for $3.5 million plus potential additional future payments.
The company had announced the signing of a letter of intent for the transaction on December 13, 1996.
Italian Oven, which is in reorganization under Chapter 11 of the Bankruptcy Code, operates and franchises Italian-theme, casual dining restaurants.
The company also said that it served a motion on each of its creditors seeking the court's approval of the sale to Whitecliff.
Whitecliff is a Minneapolis-based merchant bank funded by private equity with interests in real estate and hotels.
The court set January 17, 1997 as the date for a hearing on the motion.
The company said that if court approval of the sale is obtained, it expects the transaction to close by January 31, 1997.
